lines.say: Mortgage rates are back above seven percent.

lines.text: Freddie Mac: the 30-year fixed averaged 7.28% on Oct 1, 2026, the highest since November 2023.
lines.say: Freddie Mac's average hit seven point two eight percent, the highest since November twenty twenty-three.

lines.text: Early October each year: 2.88% in 2020, 7.28% in 2026.
lines.say: In early October twenty twenty, it was two point eight eight percent.

lines.text: The trigger: a global bond selloff. The US 10-year Treasury yield touched 5.34% intraday on Oct 1, the highest since 2002.
lines.say: The trigger is a global bond selloff. On October first, the US ten-year Treasury yield touched five point three four percent, its highest since two thousand two.

lines.text: Britain's 30-year yield topped 6%, a 1998 high. Japan's yields are near 30-year highs.
lines.say: Britain's thirty-year topped six percent, and Japan's are near thirty-year highs.

lines.text: Reuters cites energy-driven inflation, AI spending soaking up capital, and bets on Fed hikes, which cooled after Friday's weak jobs report.
lines.say: Why? Reuters points to pricey energy, AI soaking up money, and Fed hike bets, which cooled after Friday's weak jobs report.

lines.text: Example: $400,000 30-year loan, principal and interest: $2,486/mo at 6.34% (Oct 2025) vs $2,737/mo at 7.28% (Oct 2026).
lines.say: For example, a four hundred thousand dollar loan costs about two hundred fifty dollars more a month than a year ago.

lines.text: Existing fixed-rate mortgages don't change. New loans follow bonds. Next Freddie Mac reading: Thursday, Oct 8.
lines.say: Existing fixed-rate mortgages don't change. New loans follow bonds, and Freddie Mac's next reading is Thursday.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.
lines.say: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Mortgage rates are back above 7%. Blame the bond market.
post.ig:
Mortgage rates are back above 7%.
Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed averaged 7.28% on Oct 1, 2026, up from 6.34% a year earlier and the highest since November 2023.
The US 10-year Treasury yield touched 5.34% intraday on Oct 1, its highest since 2002, as bonds sold off worldwide. Britain's 30-year yield topped 6%, a 1998 high.
Example: a $400,000 30-year loan costs about $251 more a month (principal and interest) than at last year's rate.
Sources: Freddie Mac PMMS (Oct 1, 2026), Reuters.
News and education, not financial advice.
